response.rationale: R1 is the best fit: the sausage-shaped pancreas with capsule-like rim, diffuse DWI-high enlargement, and diffuse main pancreatic duct narrowing are classic for autoimmune pancreatitis. R2's CA19-9 and PET findings are nonspecific and can occur in AIP; R3 lacks the capsule-like rim and sausage morphology; C1 over-specifies Type 2 from normal IgG4 alone without histology.

rejected.why: CA19-9 and hypermetabolic lymph nodes are nonspecific; diffuse sausage-shaped pancreas and ductal narrowing argue against cancer.
Normal serum IgG4 alone cannot establish Type 2; Type 1 AIP can also have normal IgG4 and subtype requires histology.
